whats_new.title: Where you left off
whats_new.text: A new page under Your work lists every session from the last 24 hours, then the epics and tickets you were last working on, with how many tickets are done. Tick Done on anything you are finished with: it hides until there is new activity in it. Open one to see which sessions are working on it, what is waiting on you, and a short summary of where you stopped. You don't label or organise anything for it.
